name: gsm4
description: GSM4 游戏服务端管理面板

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @gsm4/server" "npm run dev -w @gsm4/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gsm4/shared && npm run build -w @gsm4/server && npm run build -w @gsm4/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @gsm4/shared && npm run typecheck -w @gsm4/server && npm run typecheck -w @gsm4/web
